prompt: Implement seconds(text) in duration.py: it turns a duration like "1h30m", "45s", "2d", "1d2h3m4s" or "90m" into a whole number of seconds. Units are d, h, m and s, each at most once and in that order; surrounding whitespace is allowed. Anything else (an empty string, "1x", "m5", "1h1h", "5m1h", "-3s", "1.5h") raises ValueError.
